newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tennis-Sampras gets back in the groove.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Sampras gets back in the groove.

text.p: World number one Pete Sampras found his rhythm quickly after a two-week break on Wednesday to sweep aside Canadian Grant Connell in a 12-player invitation event.
Sampras, out of action since winning the Swiss Indoor in Basle, defeated the unranked Connell 6-4 6-2 in 50 minutes in his opening group match of the US$596,000 Marlboro Championships.
The American fired down eight aces against doubles specialist Connell, who was playing just his second singles game in a year.

"I thought I played pretty well," said the U.S. Open winner. "This is good preparation for the tournaments coming up in Stuttgart (the Eurocard Open) and the Paris Open. Matches are much better than practice."
Fast-court expert Sampras is anticipating a showdown in the final with clay court specialist Thomas Muster of Austria, on a slow surface.
"He beat me in Essen the last time we played (last November)," said Sampras of the world number three. "This is a slow court and he can stay back -- we will see what happens."
